results.description:
Noteful is your one-stop note-taking app to experience the new paperless revolution on iPad. 

Perfect for annotating documents, taking class notes or even building your personal knowledge system. It is time to put aside the paper clutter, as Noteful is a versatile tool that helps you to accelerate your learning and knowledge work.

Take Beautiful Handwritten Notes
• Natural, fluid and precise handwriting experience
• Precise handwriting on iPad with Apple Pencil native support
• Custom-built ink engine InfiniteStroke that captures and converts your strokes into high-resolution vector ink
• 3 brushes available: ballpoint pen, fountain pen and highlighter
• Switch between pen sizes and colours
• Recognise geometrical shapes

Markup, Highlight, Annotate 
• Import PDFs, MS Office documents to a notebook
• Add images, shapes and typed text to notes
• Use multiple paper templates in a single notebook
• Export and share handwritten annotations as PDF
• Use Quick Create to create a new notebook for quick sketching

Powerful Tagging
• Organise quickly by tagging with #tag or even #nested/tag anywhere in notebooks
• More flexible than folders; Notes can be organised by subjects, by topics or by priorities
• Browse notebooks or pages by tags
• Rename, delete or re-assign tags to easily re-organise your library

Layers in Notebook
• Add annotation on separate layers without changing original content*
• Hide or show layers independently
• Rearrange layers
• Make it possible to composite complex layout*

All Your Notes, All the Time
• Sync to all your iPhone and iPad devices*
• Take textbooks, slides, handwritten notes and PDF documents with you wherever you go
• Notebooks synced with iCloud are encrypted via account-based keys

Powerful Editing
• Erase strokes with eraser
• Double tap on Apple Pencil to switch to eraser tool
• Move and resize annotations with lasso tool
• Unlimited undo, redo
• Support Split View for multitasking

Audio Record Notes
• Record audio while you take notes
• Audio playback position synced with the notes

Modern App Design
• A minimalist UI that maximizes content space
• Streamlined design that requires fewer taps for common functions
• Different orientations are available for the main toolbar
• A clean UI that lets you focus on note-taking and the content

We will be adding new features so please stay tuned for future updates.

—
Noteful is free to use without time limit but with certain features (marked with*) only available to users who upgrade to Noteful Pro via In-app purchase.

Noteful Pro is available for one-time purchase and the features will be unlocked forever. 

—

If you have support questions or product suggestions, please contact us by support. 

Wishing you happy note-taking!

Customer Support: support@getnoteful.com
Privacy Policy: https://www.getnoteful.com/privacy

results.description:
Notes Writer brings handwriting, PDFs, voice, documents and AI together on iPad and iPhone. Take notes in class, mark up a contract, record a meeting or plan a thesis, and keep it all in one place that is easy to search and share.

HANDWRITING THAT FEELS LIKE PAPER
• Write with Apple Pencil using pens, pencils, markers, fountain pens and watercolor brushes, and refine with the lasso, ruler and shapes.
• Mix handwriting, typed text, images, stickers and audio on one page.
• Choose blank, ruled, Cornell, planner, music or graph paper.
• Search your handwriting, check its spelling, or convert it to text, math or LaTeX.
• Tap your ink to hear what was said as you wrote it.

FOR STUDENTS
• Record lectures while you write, then search the transcript.
• Hide key facts under Tape, reveal them one by one and turn them into flashcards.
• Study flashcards with spaced repetition, reminders and a Home Screen widget.
• Make a quiz from your notes, a topic or pasted text, and score yourself.
• Circle a problem with Magic Lasso and ask AI to explain, solve or check it.
• Find free open textbooks and keep each subject together in a Study Project.

FOR PROFESSIONALS
• Meeting Notes records and transcribes the meeting, enhances your notes and writes a summary with action items.
• Mark up PDFs, fill forms, sign, measure plans and redact text.
• Scan paper documents and recognize their text.
• Present on an external display or with AirPlay, using a laser pointer.
• Brainstorm on whiteboards with sticky notes, images and recordings.
• Open Word, RTF, Markdown and plain text, and export to PDF, DOCX, RTF, HTML or EPUB.

FOR WRITERS AND RESEARCHERS
• Draft in rich text and keep your sources open in tabs.
• Organize long projects in the Binder, plan on the Corkboard, save snapshots and compile a manuscript or ebook.
• Write LaTeX papers with a live PDF preview.
• Combine explanations, graphs, charts and Python cells in Math Notebooks.
• Structure ideas as outlines and exchange them in OPML.

AI THAT WORKS WITH YOUR NOTES
• Rewrite, simplify, translate, or fix spelling and grammar.
• Ask questions and get answers from your own notes, PDFs and transcripts.
• Summarize a reading, a recording or a meeting. You decide what goes into your notes.

YOUR NOTES, YOUR WAY
• Import notes from other note-taking apps.
• Sketch with graphite and charcoal, or paint with watercolor, oils and acrylics.
• Share an iPad with separate profiles, each with its own notes and an optional passcode.
• Keep folders with covers, and work with files in iCloud Drive, Dropbox, Google Drive and the Files app.
• Autosave, recovery, backups and passcodes protect your work.

CollaNote: Powerful note-taking app packed with a wide range of tools.

IMPORT, MARK-UP, AND EXPORT PDF:

- In-built scanner to digitize your physical documents.
- Export notes to PDF and share with ease.

POWERFUL TOOLS:

- Password protection for ultimate note security.

AI POWERED:
- Built-in AI Calculator for complex calculations.
- AI drawing tools for perfect shapes.

Download CollaNote now to discover even more surprises!
